description: This file defines various classes for handling HTTP authentication schemes in FastAPI, including Basic, Bearer, Digest, and general HTTP authentication base class, along with their credentials models.

classes.name: HTTPBasicCredentials
classes.description: Model representing HTTP Basic authentication credentials with username and password.

classes.name: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
classes.description: Model representing HTTP authorization credentials with scheme and credentials.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Base class for HTTP authentication schemes, providing common functionality.

classes.name: HTTPBasic
classes.description: Implementation of HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Implementation of HTTP Bearer token authentication scheme.

classes.name: HTTPDigest
classes.description: Stub implementation for HTTP Digest authentication scheme.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the request to extract authentication credentials.
